insight: Its open-source (MIT) Python/TS SDK instruments an agent in two lines of code and integrates with 400+ LLMs and agent frameworks.
name: AgentOps
tagline: Observability and tracing built for AI agents.
description: AgentOps is a developer platform for monitoring, debugging, and evaluating AI agents. It records every LLM call, tool use, and decision in a replayable session trace, with time-travel debugging, token and cost tracking, and agent benchmarking. Its open-source SDK drops into Python or TypeScript agents in two lines and integrates with frameworks like CrewAI, LangChain, Autogen, and the OpenAI Agents SDK.

modelSupport.notes: Framework- and model-agnostic; traces calls across 400+ LLMs and agent SDKs.

edge: Purpose-built for multi-step agents — session replay with time-travel debugging and per-run cost tracking, not just flat LLM-call logging.
pros: Records every LLM call, tool use, decision
cons: Full analytics rely on the hosted dashboard
